entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Security Hardening] Remove or gate MONO_ENV_OPTIONS → popen() path in profiler code before any future desktop shipping #126808

Closed

  • Avx10 cannot be detected #126677
  • System.Runtime.InteropServices.Tests.DestroyStructureTests.DestroyStructure_Blittable_Success failing in CI #126788
  • Interpreter: volatile ldobj appears to have incorrect semantics? #3865
    Future
  • Looks like the generated code for XUnitWrapperGenerator for handling Theory dynamic member data is broken. #126504

PullRequests

Created

  • Generate line number info in ilc and crossgen #126813
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr

    area-CodeGen-coreclr

    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, community-contribution

    area-Infrastructure
  • Haiku: Native support #126805

  • Use source-build-assets repo #126804

    area-Infrastructure

    area-System.Buffers
